title: routeDiscoveryClient
summary: Create the browser side of route discovery for a build.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: virtual:smolter/routes exports discover = routeDiscoveryClient(build) when routeDiscovery is configured, importing it from lazy-route for flat routes or nested for nested routes. Pass discover to mountApplication or createRouter.

sections.title: Requests
sections.body: For an unmatched URL it requests /path.__smolter-routes (following your namespace) same-origin with cache: no-store and the router's abort signal, then validates the response before creating lazy routes. Non-2xx and malformed responses yield no routes.

sections.title: Modules and styles
sections.body: A discovered route loads its stylesheets, then imports its module and reads only the listed exports. A failed import dispatches vite:preloadError so watchDeployment can recover, then rejects for the route's error boundary.

sections.title: Stale builds
sections.body: When the response comes from another build, a page navigation loads the destination as a new document and other callers receive no routes. Writes are never replayed.
